description: No external migration standards paths were configured and the extension evidence manifest contains no resources (input hash 5b1d74f72d5f8d7746a3bac90b12b7a4e3b15264854c4ebd92c989f23a926174). Architecture and implementation conventions therefore cannot be validated against external standards.

The binding supplies only an application-relative WCF-WebHttp address and Transport security. Target hostname, certificate, DNS, ingress exposure, authorization policy, client identity requirements, and throttling equivalents are not supplied; client credential type is explicitly None in the source.

The accepted-notice archive is a local Windows FILE path. No target Azure storage service, connection, share/container, identity, network configuration, retention, replay, or purge policy is supplied.

No orchestration catch/fault response contract is defined. The WCF binding disables exception details and SuspendMessageOnFailure, but externally visible failure status/body and operational handling are not specified.

The response is sent before conditional archival. The source defines three archive FILE retries at five-minute intervals but no terminal alert/dead-letter behavior, so the desired response-versus-archive failure semantics need confirmation.
